pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on scaling into consecutive losing ticks or adding positions within 5 minutes of a previous stop-out; only pyramid when existing open positions show a minimum unrealized profit of +$10.00.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory 15-minute ATR volatility filter and order-book imbalance check; block all entries if spread exceeds 35% of the average 14-period bar range or during high-impact macro news windows.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stops or partial profit scaling the moment an open trade crosses +$12.00, locking in a guaranteed floor to prevent profit evaporation.
